## Simulation Guide Agent: Expert Guidance for Every Engineer, Tailored to Any Workflow


Jacob Beardslee


August 28, 2026


Make simulation expertise easier to access across your organization. Rescale’s Simulation Guide Agent uses trusted technical documentation, user guides, templates, and team best practices to help users ask better questions, interpret results, select an appropriate workflow, configure jobs correctly, and verify recommendations before taking action, all within the existing simulation workflow on Rescale.


[Learn more](https://rescale.com/platform/agentic-engineering/) about how Rescale agents provide simulation guidance that’s specific to your organization and available where engineering work happens.
